R03:
A UI adds editable ingredient estimates. The normal draft title and designation controls still need to work while idle. After a new estimate arrives, ingredient data should update.
Existing view:
  ReviewScroll(titleEditor, designationPicker, ingredientsEditor)
     .disabled(model.isRecalculating)
The title and designation setters are only called from those controls. The adapter sets isRecalculating=true before starting the request, calls apply(estimate) synchronously on the UI actor, then sets it false. The proposed apply method updates the ingredient rows and initializes an automatic title only when the snapshot did not have a manual title. There are no background writers to title/designation. A test exercises completing the estimate and editing after it settles.
R05:
A research proposal examines how to detect failed review delivery. Health is defined as a verdict posted to the expected discussion with the required success marker. The successful reviewed run below posted a correctly linked marked verdict. The executor reported two permission denials on unrelated optional reads.
diff: + Set an alert when the expected verdict is missing after execution.
A metric readout includes a permission_denied count in addition to marker/verdict receipt. The team wants the smallest reliable detector and will later decide how to log optional tool errors.
R06:
This patch accepts a dated issuer-cap fixture. A previously successful acquisition path emits two kinds of evidence. An ordinary cover-page share count must be effective on or before publication. A verified offering statement may give a future effective date, which is acceptable only after that effective date and after publication. The source-bound company census already distinguishes offering evidence and gives its effective date.
diff: + if (row.effective > row.published || row.published > requestedDay)
      +   throw InvalidCapEvidence();
Fixture visible in the proposed tests: ordinary share count published May 11/effective May 9. Current source-bound fixture data can also emit a verified offering statement published May 9/effective May 11 for a May 12 replay.
